documents.title: Report of the Committee on Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence in University of Louisville Academics
tiers: May be used with prior instructor permission and appropriate attribution and citation
documents.summary: A March 2024 provost-appointed committee report to the University of Louisville with recommendations on syllabus statements, Student Code changes, teaching, training and research. It offers three sample syllabus positions and leaves the choice to instructors. It also covers research cautions, detectors and governance.
documents.stance_why: The report says the committee is "hesitant to prescribe any one policy for the entire university" and asks faculty to choose among three syllabus positions, so it sets no stance itself and delegates; the three positions are listed as tiers.

new_types.name: Resource AI infrastructure, centers and support
new_types.definition: The institution funds, founds or assesses the resourcing of AI infrastructure, a dedicated AI center, support staff or tool portals for teaching and research. Evidence: Louisville committee report (center for AI research, computational infrastructure, tool portal, ITS resourcing).

notes: Merged from coders A and B. Documents: the March 2024 provost-appointed committee report (a recommendation document, not an adopted policy; its Student Code text is proposed) and the Delphi Center Generative AI and Teaching page. No school or computing-unit policy found; course layer deferred. The saved Delphi text has no syllabus-guideline section. The report's three sample syllabus positions appear both in the table of contents and in the body; one unit per position, anchored on the heading text. Dropped B-only unit: the Academic Dishonesty preamble ('makes accurate evaluation of student progress impossible'), which is not AI-specific. Coder notes kept: anchors with odd spacing (e.g. 'summarizesomeone', 'tools , to') follow the source text; many report units concern research use and university governance. The new type 'Resource AI infrastructure, centers and support' is proposed because the AI research center, computing infrastructure, tool portal, ITS resourcing and Delphi resourcing units recur as UNCOVERED or partial fits.
